notes: Three more security fixes. Rolling back can no longer install code the assistant could have written: backups now live where only root can write, and root refuses any backup that someone else could have changed. 'Open an app' now opens only real applications — the built-in ones, anything from the Apps page, or the Apps menu — and only with files or web addresses, never options; running commands stays behind its confirmation. And the old second copy of the service units is gone, so every installation runs the assistant as the unprivileged osprime user.
